sourceName: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE), Ministry of MSME
documentTitle: CGTMSE Collateral-Free Credit Scheme Guidelines FY 2025-26

chunks.text: CGTMSE provides collateral-free credit facilities up to ₹5 Crore for new and existing Micro and Small Enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors. The guarantee coverage is up to 85% for micro enterprises.
Eligibility factors require a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, clean credit history, and minimum 2 years of operational manufacturing history for existing units seeking credit expansion.
